messages:
samir: Heads-up — I'm planning a tiny TF change to ExternalSecret annotations: add `rotation_jitter` and replace the `secret.rewiring/consumers` freeform list with a normalized `consumer.labels` key. Before I open the PR, does anyone know of services that parse the old key?

claire: what does the TF diff look like? can you paste the snippet?

samir: sure, here's the change i'm about to apply in the module:

```
# before
external_secret_annotations = {
  "secret.rewiring/consumers" = join(",", var.consumer_services)
}

# after
external_secret_annotations = merge(
  {
    "rotation.window" = var.rotation_window
    "rotation.jitter" = var.rotation_jitter
  },
  length(var.consumer_labels) > 0 ? {"consumer.labels" = jsonencode(var.consumer_labels)} : {}
)
```

samir: The idea is to stop stuffing comma lists into a single key so we can query by label in the controller and avoid brittle parsing. Also adding jitter so rotations from many secrets don't spike at the same second.

jonathan: That seems sensible. A couple questions: what format will `consumer.labels` be? map? array?

samir: `consumer_labels` is a map in TF, e.g. { "app" = "payments", "team" = "checkout" } and we jsonencode it into the annotation. The controller will interpret json and match.

claire: Any backwards compat concerns? existing controllers expecting `secret.rewiring/consumers` might break.

samir: yes — planned strategy: annotation migration on rollout. The controller will accept both keys for 2 releases: read `consumer.labels` if present, else fallback to parsing `secret.rewiring/consumers`. After a couple weeks we'll remove fallback.

infra-bot: note: terraform plan for module `k8s-secrets` will change 12 resources. No deletions expected. Run `tf plan` in staging first. :gear:

samir: Thanks infra-bot. I'm going to open the PR with the TF changes + controller compat layer. Can reviewers please watch for any hardcoded string parsing in apps? Link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4212

jonathan: I'll grep for "secret.rewiring/consumers" across services that touch secrets. If I find a consumer that parses it, i'll post a snippet.

claire: also check ops-runbooks we added last year; someone might have a doc that references the annotation.

ops-oncall: FYI, when you add `rotation.jitter` please keep max jitter <= rotation.window/2 so we don't push some rotations beyond expected SLA. I can watch the rotation jobs in staging during the rollout.

samir: good call — i'll default jitter to 10% of the window but cap at 6h. PR will include a comment and a small migration plan in the CHANGELOG.

jonathan: found one parser in payments-service: infra/utils/secret_client.go lines 88-104. It splits on comma. i'll open a quick PR to make it robust to both formats.

claire: awesome. once jonathan's PR is up and tests pass we can merge the infra change and run a canary deploy to staging cluster only.

samir: timeline: open infra PR now, wait for jonathan's consumer fix, merge both, then TF apply to staging this afternoon. ops-oncall please watch rotations between 3–5pm.

ops-oncall: i'll be online. if we see rotation failures i'll pause the controller via k8s rollout pause and revert the TF change. :eyes:

samir: thanks all. I'll @mention again when PRs are green. :thumbsup:
